description.narrative: This activity Programme Capital for Rights and Governance Challenge Fund accoutable grant is a component of Rights and Governance Challenge fund reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £500,000. It works in the following sector(s): Democratic participation and civil society, Human rights, Public finance management (PFM).
